description: Operator view of the 48 Blackbox HTTP probes: availability, HTTP status, response time, and SSL expiry.

panels.description: Current UP and DOWN counts. This replaces the state timeline, which stayed blank: Grafana draws that panel only between value changes and disconnects the 30s probe samples, so a site that stays up or down for the whole range has no visible bar.
panels.title: Website Availability Overview

panels.description: Probe duration for each website. Green under 2s, orange from 2s to 5s, red above 5s.
panels.title: Website Response Time

panels.description: Websites whose latest Blackbox probe failed (probe_success = 0). HTTP 503, 502, 401, and 403 are the status code Blackbox received. No HTTP response means the probe got no status line (DNS, connection, or TLS); it is not labeled a timeout unless the probe runs into the 15s limit.
